goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate the calendar to the next month, and select a specific date to filter memos for that day.

findings.instruction: In the July 2026 calendar view, click on the date '15' to select July 15.
findings.title: Calendar reverted to June 2026 after selecting July 15
findings.description: After clicking the date '15' in July 2026, the calendar unexpectedly reverted to displaying June 2026 instead of remaining on July 2026 with the selected date highlighted. This breaks the expected workflow where the calendar should stay on the selected month.
findings.evidence: In the BEFORE screenshot, the calendar header shows 'July 2026'. In the AFTER screenshot, the calendar header shows 'June 2026', even though the URL filter and memo input correctly reflect the July 15 selection.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the calendar view showing July 2026.
Click on the date '15' in the July 2026 calendar.
Observe that the calendar header changes to 'June 2026' instead of staying on July 2026.

findings.instruction: In the July 2026 calendar view, click on the date '15' to select July 15.
findings.title: Selected date '15' is not visually highlighted in the calendar
findings.description: After selecting July 15, the date '15' in the calendar grid does not show any visual indication (e.g., highlight, border, or background color) to indicate it is the currently selected date.
findings.evidence: In the AFTER screenshot, the calendar displays June 2026, and none of the dates (including '15' which is visible in June) appear highlighted or selected, despite the URL and memo input confirming the selection of July 15.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the calendar view showing July 2026.
Click on the date '15' in the July 2026 calendar.
Observe that the date '15' in the calendar grid lacks any visual selection indicator.
